sources.attribution: Community data maintained by BSData; per-catalogue authorName and authorContact metadata are retained above. Repository README says the project is community maintained and not endorsed by BattleScribe or any publisher.
sources.license: No LICENSE, COPYING, or NOTICE file was located in the checked-out repository. Redistribution permission for catalogue data is unverified; obtain rights review/permission before public or commercial distribution.
sources.freshness: Converted from the supplied checkout commit dated 2026-02-03. The GitHub README latest-release badge resolves to 1.7.8 (2025-10-08); this checkout is a later snapshot, not a claim that a newer tagged release was verified.
sources.deduplication: Byte-identical upgrade definitions represented by the same name, points, slot, uniqueness, and rule profile are neutralized only when present in all four faction catalogues. Partial overlap stays faction-bound.

distributionCaveat: This file records provenance, not a legal opinion or a claim that Star Wars names/rules text are cleared for distribution. Review upstream licenses and applicable third-party rights before release.
artworkPolicy: No artwork is copied or linked. imageUrl and imageAssetPath are null for every card.

slotMapping.armada: Ship Upgrade Bar and the nearest BSData upgrade group map to the existing ArmadaSlot enum. Title groups map to TITLE; Commander cards use COMMANDER; unsupported labels map to OTHER and are retained in rulesText. This standalone file contains only Armada cards; merge its cards array with other game catalogs to build the app-wide catalog.
